char.name: Clarence
char.text: Whoa! Tomorrow is Mom's birthday. I'm gonna get her the BEST present ever!
Now where did I put my money? It's gotta be in my room somewhere.
Looks like a perfect day for mud volcanoes, but I gotta buy Mom's present first.
Oh, Mr. Sharky? He's just taking a nap.
That's my collection of invisible pocket watches.
That's just my infinity-ball racket.
Hmm.... I don't think this is the right tool.
I call this my bedside deskabench!
Here it is! Lemme put it on my deskabench.
Now, how to open you up, Mr. Swinefellow?
"My First Claw Hammer"... Chad gives me the best Christmas presents..
Sorry, Mr. Swinefellow! I'll glue you together later.
Let's see.... What do we have here?
Two buttons, three quarters and a potato chip.
I dunno if this will be enough for the perfect birthday present, but I gotta try!
Wait for me!

char.name: Mary
char.text: Clarence! Get ready. We're going out for lunch!

char.name: Clarence
char.text: I finished my lunch, Mom. Can I go to the park and play?
Because... err... I need fresh air, and sun! For growing and all that.
Hmm.... Not by myself, eh? I guess I need to do this on the buddy system!
Hey, Jeff!
I'm trying to escape from my Mom.
Because I want to get her a surprise birthday present, so it has to be top secret.
Probably! Come with me, my friend!
Wait here.
Don't worry! Jeff'll come with me!
Umm... Nothing right now, thanks!
I would like one of your fancy burritos, my good man.
Don't mind if I do!
Sorry, but that's all I've got.
Just passing through, Mr. Rough Riders Counter Man Guy.
Give it here. My friends call me Professor Puzzle! Well, not really. They usually just call me Clarence.
Thanks!
I don't have time right now to search you for hidden treasures, Mr. Trash Can. Maybe later.
"Authorized personnel only." Whatever that means.
There's no time to play right now! I gotta get Mom a birthday present.
I was looking for the perfect present for the perfect mom. And guess what? I found it!
Happy birthday, Mom!
You're never too old to have fun! Come on! I'll teach you!
They aren't old. They're "vin-tage," Mom. "Vin-tage." That means they're really special.
Happy birthday, Mom!

char.name: Mary
char.text: Why don't you play in here?The "Fun Dungeon" is right over there.
What?(DELETED)
Sorry, Honey, but I'd rather you not go out by yourself. Wait for us. I'm about to finish my birthday fries.
Hi, Jeff. Well, I guess it's OK, then. Don't go too far, though.
Where have you been, mister?
A... skateboard.... Thanks, honey. But I'm afraid I might be too old for this.
A stuffed animal! It's adorable, Clarence. Thank you so much.
It doesn't matter, it's cute!
Thank you, Clarence. This is perfect.
A huge bag of candy? But are you sure these are safe to eat? They look a little old.
Just like you, sweetie. Thank you, Clarence.

char.name: Chad
char.text: Yeah, Mary! Kids are like little weird plants, they need that stuff.
Hang in there, kid! Don't wither away!(DELETED)
What kind of animal is that?

char.name: Jeff
char.text: Hey, Clarence! What are you doing?
Why?
I see. Is there anything I can do to help?
Hello, Mary!

char.name: Joshua
char.text: Yeah, what do you want?
Today only, Hawaiian-Greek Burritos are on clearance for just 75 cents.
Would you like to Enormo-Size your meal for only $9.99?
Here you go. Enjoy your meal or whatever.
You again? What is it now?
Whatever. I'm just in a bad mood because of this dumb weekly menu they make me do.
There's no way to fit all of it on a single page.
Here it is, but I'm telling you: It's impossible.
Thanks a lot. You want one of these discount burritos for your help? It's on the house.

char.name: Sumo
char.text: To the ball pit!

char.name: Clarence
char.text: Don't worry. I'm the Birthday Wizard. I'll be back here in no time.
Hey, Harry. I gotta find the best birthday present for my Mom.
The most super amazing thing that anybody's ever seen in the entire world.
For 75 cents. Or less.
Harry looks really sad. I bet a burrito would cheer him up!
Guess what I've got, Harry! One of those fancy Hawaii burrito things you talk about all the time!
Yah, but don't worry about it. I know just what to do next.
Hey, Dustin! Those are some sweet kung fu moves.
Oh, cool. Hey, do you got any secret karate moves for that "Merciless Fighters" game?
Oh man, Dustin's hungry, too? Coming up with burrito #2!
Dustin, your belly deserves a break from all this kung fu. Here, eat this.
Harry looks sad. I gotta help him somehow.
He does like burritos. And burritos always make me happy.
I'll remember that in my wizard brain.
Pizza Swamp Game Tournament. "The winner will get...
...one of our finest prizes." Mom loves finest prizes! That would be the perfect birthday present!
Here, try these beauties on for size.
There's a ticket in here!

char.name: Jeff
char.text: I'd like to go with you, Clarence, but I can't walk on that grass wearing sandals. My feet might get dirty.
Sorry, but I can't go with you wearing these sandals. Maybe if I had some other shoes.
I appreciate the thought, Clarence, but I can't wear those boots. They're filthy.
Hmm. You cleaned these up really nicely, Clarence. And they fit pretty well, too. Thanks!
Let's go to Pizza Swamp! I want to see what's going on with the tournament.

char.name: Harry
char.text: Sure, my boy. What are you looking for?
Well, I just happen to know of something super amazing.
Rough Riders' HAWAIIAN-GREEK BURRITO! What a delicacy! I wish I had one right now.
What? Did you spend the money for your Mom's present?
Thank you, Clarence. Here, take this golden coin.
I tried to buy a Hawaiian-Greek Burrito with it, but they said it's worthless.
Thanks again for the HGB! That's what I like to call it.

char.name: Dustin
char.text: It's not kung fu! It's karate!
Yeah, I know one. I can't remember it right now, though.
I'm so hungry, I can't think about anything but food. Sorry!
Um, it's actually karate, but thanks, Clarence! I'm starting to remember now.
The secret combo for "Merciless Fighters" is: A - A - B - B - A - B - A - B...
You have to hit the buttons really fast in that order.

char.name: Sumo
char.text: C'mon, Clarence!

char.name: Clarence
char.text: Excuse me! Have you seen any Pizza Swamp tokens in there?
Say no more, my flailing friend. Consider me your ball pit lifeguard.
All right! We just gotta zip back to Pizza Swamp, and I'll have my Mom's birthday present in no time!

char.name: Sumo
char.text: OK. See you at the bottom of the pit!
Cannonball!
No tokens, but I found this ticket. Must be worth something.

char.name: LittleKid
char.text: Beats me. I'm kind of stuck. Can you help me get out?
Thanks for saving me! I found this token while you were dragging me out of there. Here you go!

char.name: Clarence
char.text: Vee Eye Pee, you say? What's that?
You mean a golden token like this one?
I got a golden token. Does that make me a Vee Eye Pee?
Oh, pencils! I gotta learn how to do that top secret move.
But where can I learn such smooth moves?
Can I play again?
(DELETED)
How are you?
Hey, Sumo!
Yeah, I'm trying to win an amazing birthday present for my Mom.
It's now or never. I gotta get that prize for my Mom's birthday!
Thanks!
What makes them Very Important?
No, I don't think so.
Hey, Mister! Here's a golden token. Does this make me a Vee Eye Pee now?
Hey, Kimby! Are you here for the tournament?
I'm gonna win my Mom the finest of prizes for her birthday!
Oh, crumbles! This is tougher than it looks. I wonder who's got the high score. First Place:
...Kimby? Whoa! I should ask her for some expert computer line racing tips.
Hey, Kimby! You're like the Duchess of Speedvania on that "Crypt Racing" game. I bet you could win the tournament!
Really? I think you might want to look again. 'Cause they're pretty awesome. What kind of prize were you looking for?
Deal!
A claw crane game! It's full of teddy bears... and one cute little yellow bird!
Yep! That's Quacky all right. But I need a token to play the game.
How did you get buried under this mountain of teddy bears so far from home, Quacky?
I can't spend my "Pizza Swamp Collector's Edition Golden Token," or I won't be a Vee Eye Pee. I need a regular token.
I wonder if Sumo has any? He's always got good stuff.
Hi, Sumo. You know where I could get a token?
For the claw! I'll be right back, Sumo.
All right, Mr. Quacksby... You stay on that claw, OK?
Got it! Wait'll I introduce you to Kimby!
OK, here goes nothing.
Kimby's gonna love you, Quacksby!
(deleted)
(deleted)
What does that do?
I better talk to Kimby first. She's a real pro.
I gotta get that toy for Kimby, so I can learn her racing wisdom. I'm coming for you, Quacksby!
OK. Gas... check! Brakes... check! I'm ready for a new race!
Yeah! I got the high score in "Crypt Racer"!
Oops!
That was close! I got the high score in this game right before it broke.
Hey, Belson! Are you playing in the tournament?
So you must be here for the pizza! They got all the best toppings... cheese, pepperoni, ham, extra cheese...
RESERVED
Anything for my best buddy Belson!
I'm on it!
Yes! How about these?
Everything! But what's your cheapest prize?
Sounds fancy. I don't got that many tickets, though.
It's locked. I would cast a wizard spell, but that could get messy. Looks like I'm gonna need the Key of Infinite Opening.
Aw, neat! The secret entrance to Mr. Prize Stand Man's office.
Sticky, huh? You mean like chewing gum?
Un-chewed gum is my middle name! Not really!
I got 5 tickets! I'll take that weird gum, please!
Wow, this gum looks really old. Did cavemen chew this stuff?
Here you go, Jeff! I think he said it was "vin-tage" gum, so I hope that means it's good for sticking stuff together.
No thanks necessary. Just your friendly neighborhood wizard! And my trusty elf companion. Let's play the game again!
All right. Time to crank this baby up and make some music.
Let's try again!
Mom is gonna love this!
There's a ticket in here!
I'll save this game for the last.

char.name: Employee1
char.text: Sorry, but tournament games are for VIP members only.
You need a golden token, but they're already sold out for the day.
Yep, you're a VIP. Enjoy!
(DELETED)
(DELETED)
As a VIP member, you can play as many times as you want, but it's not gonna be easy.
This kid has been winning every match.
Hey, everybody! We've got a new champion!
You just barely made it, kid. The tournament period for Merciless Fighters is officially over.
(DELETED)
(DELETED)
Hey, it's the Merciless Fighters champ! You've got a real shot at winning this tournament.

char.name: Sumo
char.text: Hey, Clarence! You here for the tournament?
Oh, that's easy. All you gotta do is bust out the highest score in three games:
"Merciless Fighters," "CryptoPunk Race" and "Rocking Heroes".
(DELETED)
Good Luck! I'm here for ya, buddy!
Hi, Clarence.
Sure, you can have my emergency token. Uh-oh. I think I lost it at the Fun Dungeon.
I bet it's in the ball pit. But we'll find it. Follow me!
So, why do you need a token so bad?
This way, Clarence!
Why don't you ask Jeff to fix the guitar?
Not so secret now. C'mon! Let's take a look.
Find any more tickets in the trash? Or other good stuff?
Way to go, buddy!

char.name: Kimby
char.text: Nah. The only thing I wanted to win was a Quacky plushie, but they're out of them. How about you?
(deleted)
Do you mean "CryptoPunk Race"? Yeah, I could win, but I don't like any of the prizes.
(deleted)
I'll tell you what: If you can get me a Quacky plushie somehow, I'll show you how to win at "CryptoPunk Race".
Have you found me a Quacky yet?
(deleted)
(deleted)
(deleted)
Quacky! Awww, he's so adorable! OK, a deal's a deal. Here's the secret for CryptoPunk Race:
At the start of the race, just hit the gas 10 times before the countdown ends. Remember: 10 times before you see the word "GO!"
(deleted)
You'll get a special Turbo Boost that'll make you fly. Thanks for my Quacky, and don't forget to buckle up!

char.name: Employee2
char.text: Sorry, kid, but this game is reserved for VIPs today. Very. Important. Players.
They have a Pizza Swamp Collector's Edition Golden Token. Do you have a Pizza Swamp Collector's Edition Golden Token?
Then you aren't a VIP. Sorry.
Of course! Please, help yourself, sir.
It's "CryptoPunk Race", but you're right. Hey, everybody! We've got a new champion!
I guess you used too much Turbo Boost this time. Well, that's it for this old cabinet.
Don't worry, though. Your high score is safe.

char.name: Employee3
char.text: Did you kids break this again? I'll have to call your parents unless you can fix it.
Hello. See anything you like?
Let's see. Here, our "Boogie Bomb" bubble gum, vintage edition. It only costs 5 redemption tickets.
You seem like a good kid, but I can't just give you the prize. They keep a strict count of the tickets around here.
Did you find that ticket yet? It's in the filing cabinet where we keep all our customer complaints.
Do you have 5 tickets for that bubble gum you wanted? Keep looking around. I'm sure you'll find some more.
Sorry, kid. The cheapest prize we have costs 5 redemption tickets.
Of course!
Here it is: "Boogie Bomb" bubble gum. A classic treat in its day. Which was 1975.
Heh, I don't think so, kid. But we prefer to say "vintage" insead of "old." "Vin-tage." Sounds more valuable that way.
Hey, everyone! We've got a new high score in "Rocking Heroes"!
Unbelievable! We have a champion! Clarence got first place in all the tournament games.
Come on up to choose your prize!
OK, kid. Choose wisely. These are our finest prizes.
But I think I left an extra ticket in the filing cabinet in the office. If you find it, you can have it. Here's the key.

char.name: Belson
char.text: Pff! I don't need a lame prize to prove anything. I'm the best player in Aberdale, and everyone knows it.
Nah, I just wanted to play some "Rocking Heroes," but this stupid guitar couldn't keep up with my awesome riffs.
No no no, I can fix it! Psst! Clarence! Put yourself to good use and bring me some tools to fix this piece of junk.
(deleted)
You got my tools yet?
What am I supposed to do with these lousy tools? I can't work with such shoddy instruments.
Can't you find anybody else to help with this?
Yeah, I totally could have fixed that by myself. But whatever.
I could've won this tournament if I wanted to. Those games are so easy.

char.name: Jeff
char.text: Looks like the tournament will be over soon. Let me know if you need any help from me.
I could probably help Belson fix that guitar, but I don't have any tools.
Great! These tools are perfect. But I need something to hold these parts together. Something sticky.
I was thinking of a polymer-based adhesive, but I guess gum might work. Only un-chewed gum, though. OK?
Have you found any adhesive yet? Even chewing gum might work.
Cool! I love retro packaging. This should do it. Give me a minute.
Aaand... it's working again!
Now you can get a present for your Mom.

char.name: Clarence
char.text: Whoa! It's the biggest office I've ever seen. So cool! But I don't see any filing cabinets around here. What do they look like?
(deleted)
I guess this is the "cabinet" he was talking about? It smells like Chad's feet.
Wait a minute.... Oh! Sumo! I found a ticket!
Boots! Maybe these'll help Jeff cross the grass. I gotta shine 'em up first!
Then Jeff can come to Pizza Swamp with us!
Ooh! The fountain of Unending Water. So it is real...
Oh! I can wash Jeff's boots here.
Just like new!
Hmm, these are some pretty sweet tools. Oooh, never know when you'll need these!
I bet these tools will save my life one day.

char.name: Sumo
char.text: I dunno. Like a big metal box or something? Maybe he means one of these dumpsters.
Yeah! I bet you can find more tickets in the trash. Trash cans always have cool stuff.

Put the piggy bank on your desk.
